intake.business_request_raw: Magicbox adopt-mode increment — verify Developer auto-approves and skips sealed modules.
assumptions: Sealed modules are clearly defined and identifiable.
Developer actions are well-documented and standardized.

domain_invariants.statement: Define explicit error handling and observability requirements.

scenarios.name: Developer action auto-approval
gherkin: Given a developer action is submitted
Then it should be auto-approved if no exceptions apply

scenarios.name: Identifying sealed modules
gherkin: When the system processes the list
Then it should correctly identify and flag sealed modules

scenarios.name: Handling errors during approval

Then it should be logged and notified appropriately

gherkin: Given the approval process is running

open_questions.question: Are there existing operational constraints or integration dependencies not listed?
What are target latency, throughput, and availability SLOs?

risks.description: Incorrect identification of sealed modules could lead to processing errors.
risks.mitigation: Implement thorough testing and validation of module identification logic.

risks.description: Automated approval process might bypass necessary manual checks.
risks.mitigation: Define clear criteria for actions that require manual approval.

out_of_scope: Changes to the underlying database schema.

features.title: Auto-Approval of Developer Actions
features.gherkin:
Feature: Auto-Approval
Scenario: Developer action auto-approval
Given a developer action is submitted
When the action is processed
Then it should be auto-approved if no exceptions apply

features.title: Identification of Sealed Modules
features.gherkin:
Feature: Sealed Module Identification
Scenario: Identifying sealed modules
Given a list of modules
When the system processes the list
Then it should correctly identify and flag sealed modules

features.title: Error Handling in Approval Process
features.gherkin:
Feature: Error Handling
Scenario: Handling errors during approval
Given an error occurs during approval
When the error is detected
Then it should be logged and notified appropriately

features.title: Logging and Monitoring
features.gherkin:
Feature: Logging and Monitoring
Scenario: Monitoring approval process
Given the approval process is running
When an action is approved
Then it should be logged with a timestamp

must.title: Security of Approval Process
must.description: Ensure the approval process is secure and resistant to unauthorized access.
must.metric: No unauthorized access incidents in the approval process.
acceptance_criteria: Access controls are enforced for all approval actions.
All security incidents are logged and reviewed.

should.title: Performance of Approval Process
should.description: Ensure the approval process is completed within a defined time frame.
should.metric: Approval process completes within 5 seconds for 95% of actions.
acceptance_criteria: 95% of approval actions complete within 5 seconds.
System performance does not degrade under peak load.
Performance metrics are logged and reviewed monthly.
should.verification: Load test at 10× expected peak; measure p95/p99.

should.title: Scalability of Approval System
should.description: The system should scale to handle increased load without performance degradation.
should.metric: System handles 2× current load without performance loss.
acceptance_criteria: System scales to handle double the current load.
No performance degradation at increased load.

should.title: Usability of Approval Interface
should.description: The user interface for approval status should be intuitive and easy to use.
should.metric: User satisfaction score of 4.5/5 or higher.
acceptance_criteria: User satisfaction surveys score 4.5/5 or higher.
UI feedback is incorporated within 2 release cycles.
should.verification: User satisfaction surveys and usability tests.
